tools.name: product_lookup
tools.description: Look up one product by its barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A, check digit validated). Returns factual data from ProductGuru: name, brand/maker, manufacturer website (when known), category, recorded attributes, and official recall notices (agency, date, notice link), plus the URL of the Produc

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ProductGuru's published products and official recall notices. Pass a barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8 or 12-digit UPC-A) to get that product and any recall notice linked to it, or words (e.g. 'power bank') to search product names. Returns at most 10 results, each with an id, title and URL; pass an id t

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one ProductGuru record by the id that search returned: 'p:<ean>' for a product (name, brand/maker, category, recorded attributes, linked recall notices) or 'r:<recall>' for an official recall notice (issuing agency, date, summary, link to the authority's notice). Returns id, title, text, url a

tools.name: repair_nearby
tools.description: Find repair businesses near a location in France, Czechia, Slovakia, Austria or Germany (OpenStreetMap + ADEME data). Give either a barcode (ean, the product's repair category is looked up) or a repair_type, plus either lat+lon (rounded to ~1 km before use, never stored) or postcode+country. Returns

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "product_lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
